reason: I'd totally play with the free tricks if a Reel blew me away, but typing my card into some website that installs from the browser instead of the App Store? That smells like a scam to me, so I'd probably stop there.
objection: It's not in the App Store, so who's behind it, and will my card details be safe, or will it just vanish after I pay?
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it on the App Store or Google Play, or a friend in my WhatsApp group actually doing the trick on me and saying they paid and it works.
